phases.objective: Define and validate the exact evidence required before separately authorizing deferred run and plan-item foreign keys, without promoting or applying the candidate migration.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Deferred Child FK Readiness Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A checksum-bound packet reports whether all legacy-null, orphan, mismatch, duplicate-sequence, and append-only row-version metrics are zero while authorization, migration apply, and foreign-key enablement remain false.
steps: Validate the three reviewed ALTER TABLE statements and prohibit destructive or cascading DDL.
Validate the read-only counts-only parity query and pin both SQL checksums.
Bind evidence to current signed schema verification, exact runtime parity, database fingerprint, and readback cycle.
Require every legacy-null, orphan, parent mismatch, duplicate sequence, and immutable row-version violation count to be zero.
Return ready_for_separate_authorization only when all metrics pass.
Keep authorization_created, migration_apply_authorized, foreign_keys_enabled, runtime_mounted, provider_dispatch_allowed, and production_ready false.
assertions: The candidate is not present in http-generic-api/migrations.
Exactly three non-cascading foreign keys are proposed.
The evaluator imports no database or process-dispatch client.
Any non-zero blocking metric produces a stable blocker code.
Packet tampering, checksum drift, runtime/database-cycle mismatch, stale evidence, and secret-bearing fields fail closed.

phases.objective: Collect same-cycle live readback and create a separate checksum-bound authorization after explicit live-stage authority.
blockers: Live database readback has not been performed.
A fresh capability envelope and authorization registry entry have not been created.
The candidate has not been promoted to the governed runtime migration sequence.

phases.objective: Prove partial-existing-constraint, DDL retry, metadata-lock timeout, and post-apply parity handling.
No live schema mutation occurs in this repository-only slice.
Production remains blocked until authorized apply and post-apply signed readback.
